tools.name: devplatform_create
tools.description: Unified flight shop endpoint. When offer_token is present the handler re-prices that offer (price-check mode); otherwise it performs a live search by route with optional JIN-187 filter fields (cabin_class, direct_only, max_price, include_carriers, exclude_carriers). Optional: cabin_class, currency, departure_date (plus 14 more). Returns the new ShopFlightResponse.

params.name: exclude_carriers
params.description: ExcludeCarriers is a list of IATA 2-letter marketing codes to blacklist. Internally populates the connector's BlackListCarriers.MarketingCarriers.

params.name: format
params.description: Format selects the response shape. Defaults to 'text' (LLM-friendly human-readable strings). Set to 'structured' to receive the canonical flight.FlightCheckResponse with Amount objects (for client-side formatters / widgets).

params.name: include_carriers
params.description: JIN-187 filter additions. All forwarded to the connector when present. IncludeCarriers is a list of IATA 2-letter marketing codes to whitelist.

params.name: offer_token
params.description: Mode B: Price-check by offer token

tools.name: devplatform_create-admin
tools.description: Add credits to a user's rate limit balance (admin only). Required: id, amount. Returns the new UsageResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_create-keys
tools.description: Validate an API key without incrementing rate limit counter (public, no auth required). Required: api_key. Returns the new VerifyKeyResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_create-keys-2
tools.description: Verify an API key and increment rate limit counter (public, no auth required). Required: api_key. Returns the new VerifyKeyResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_create-orgs
tools.description: Create a new devplatform organization (admin only). Required: name, slug. Returns the new OrgResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_create-orgs-2
tools.description: Create a partner API key that can be used to create shadow users (admin only). Required: id, name. Returns the new CreateKeyResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_create-orgs-3
tools.description: Create a shadow user that can later be claimed by a real identity (partner key or admin auth). Required: id, email. Optional: name. Returns the new UserResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_create-users
tools.description: Create a new developer platform user (admin only). Required: email, workos_user_id. Optional: name, partner_origin. Returns the new UserResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_create-users-2
tools.description: Check whether a devplatform user exists and their current status (public, no auth). Optional: workos_user_id. Returns the new DevplatformCreateUsers2Response.

tools.name: devplatform_create-users-3
tools.description: Link a real WorkOS identity to an existing shadow user account. Email is taken from JWT, not request body. Returns the new ClaimResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_create-users-4
tools.description: Create a new API key for the authenticated user. Required: name. Returns the new CreateKeyResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_create-users-5
tools.description: Self-register a new devplatform account using the authenticated JWT identity. Optional: email, name. Returns the new UserResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_delete
tools.description: Revoke an API key by ID for the authenticated user. Required: id. Returns the DevplatformDeleteResponse. Destructive.

tools.name: devplatform_delete-orgs
tools.description: Revoke an API key for a specific user in an organization (org_admin or admin). Required: id, user_id, key_id. Returns the DevplatformDeleteOrgsResponse. Destructive.

tools.name: devplatform_get
tools.description: Get organization details by ID (org_admin or admin). Required: id. Returns the OrgResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_get-orgs
tools.description: List all users belonging to an organization (org_admin or admin). Required: id. Returns the DevplatformGetOrgsResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_get-users
tools.description: Resolve the active API key for a user by WorkOS ID (admin only). Required: workos_id. Returns the KeyListItem.

tools.name: devplatform_list
tools.description: List all devplatform organizations (admin only). Returns the DevplatformListResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_list-users
tools.description: List all users or filter by status (pending, active, suspended). Admin only. Optional: status. Returns the DevplatformListUsersResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_list-users-2
tools.description: Get the devplatform user profile for the authenticated JWT user. Returns the UserResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_list-users-3
tools.description: List all API keys for the authenticated user. Returns the DevplatformListUsers3Response.

tools.name: devplatform_list-users-4
tools.description: Get API usage and rate limit statistics for the authenticated user. Returns the UsageResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_update
tools.description: Approve a pending devplatform user by WorkOS ID (admin only). Required: workos_id. Returns the updated UserResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_update-admin
tools.description: Update the role of a devplatform user (admin only). Required: id, role. Returns the updated DevplatformUpdateAdminResponse.

tools.name: devplatform_update-orgs
tools.description: Assign a user as admin of an organization by WorkOS ID (admin only). Required: id, workos_user_id. Returns the updated UserResponse.

tools.name: flights_create
tools.description: Check a flight offer from search results to get confirmed availability and detailed fare options. Required: offer_token. Optional: provider, cabin_class, currency (plus 7 more). Returns the new FlightCheckResponse.

params.name: provider
params.description: Target a specific provider (sabre, travelfusion). When omitted, all enabled providers are called.

params.name: cabin_class
params.description: JIN-187 filter forwards. These are only meaningful for DirectShop (live search) — the /flights/check (re-price by offer token) surface ignores them because the cached offer already has a concrete cabin, carrier, and price.

params.name: offer_token
params.description: The offer token from a flight search result (find_flight or find_destination) This is the ES doc_id from the search results

params.name: passengers-adt
params.description: Number of adult passengers (12+ years), required, 1-9

params.name: passengers-chd
params.description: Number of child passengers (2-11 years), optional, 0-8

params.name: passengers-inf
params.description: Number of infant passengers (under 2 years), optional, 0-4

params.name: provider-2
params.description: Provider to target for this check (e.g., 'sabre', 'travelfusion'). When specified, only this provider is called instead of fan-out to all. When empty, all enabled providers are called in parallel.

tools.name: flights_create-destinationsearch
tools.description: Search for destination cities with cheapest flight options based on filter criteria. Optional: currency, filters, flights_per_destination (plus 6 more). Returns the new DestinationSearchResponse.

params.name: filters-cabin-class
params.description: Cabin class filter (optional): filters by cabin class

params.name: filters-dates-departure-dates
params.description: Multiple departure dates (list of specific dates)

params.name: filters-dates-return-dates
params.description: Multiple return dates (list of specific dates)

params.name: filters-dates-stay-days
params.description: Length of stay in days (for roundtrip flights)

params.name: filters-direct-only
params.description: Direct flights only (maps to lowest_direct_fare in ES)

params.name: filters-locations-destinations
params.description: One or more destination IATA codes (required)

params.name: filters-locations-origins
params.description: One or more origin IATA codes (required)

params.name: flights_per_destination
params.description: FlightsPerDestination - number of flights to return per destination bucket (default: 1, max: 10)

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit - maximum number of destinations to return (default: 20, max: 100)

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset - number of destinations to skip for pagination (default: 0)

params.name: price-constraints-max-total
params.description: Maximum total price in USD (will be converted to NUC millicents for ES query)

tools.name: flights_create-refundcheck
tools.description: Check whether a flight booking is eligible for a refund and get the refund amount. Optional: provider, booking_ref, last_name (plus 3 more). Returns the new RefundCheckResponse.

params.name: provider
params.description: Target a specific provider (sabre, travelfusion). When omitted, uses request body provider field.

tools.name: flights_create-search
tools.description: Search flights (synchronous, filter-based). Optional: allow_live_shop, currency, filters (plus 6 more). Returns the new FlightSearchResponse.

params.name: allow_live_shop
params.description: AllowLiveShop enables live shopping in parallel with cached search. Default false — only opted-in consumers (e.g. MCP FindFlight) set this to true.

params.name: filters-cabin-class
params.description: Cabin class filter (optional): filters by cabin class

params.name: filters-dates-departure-dates
params.description: Multiple departure dates (list of specific dates)

params.name: filters-dates-return-dates
params.description: Multiple return dates (list of specific dates)

params.name: filters-dates-stay-days
params.description: Length of stay in days (for roundtrip flights)

params.name: filters-direct-only
params.description: Direct flights only (maps to lowest_direct_fare in ES)

params.name: filters-locations-destinations
params.description: One or more destination IATA codes (required)

params.name: filters-locations-origins
params.description: One or more origin IATA codes (required)

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit - maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset - number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

params.name: price-constraints-max-total
params.description: Maximum total price in USD (will be converted to NUC millicents for ES query)

tools.name: hotels_create
tools.description: Search hotels with a natural-language query (e.g. 'beach. Required: check_in_date, check_out_date, destination, query. Optional: currency, guest_nationality, language (plus 2 more). Returns the new SemanticSearchResult.

tools.name: hotels_create-shop
tools.description: Search hotels by destination and return available rooms with live pricing. Required: checkin, checkout. Optional: adults, chain_ids, children (plus 18 more). Returns the new HotelShopResponse.

params.name: query
params.description: Destination — at least one must be set

tools.name: payment_create
tools.description: Create a payment authorization for a quote using Stripe. Required: quote_id. Returns the new PaymentAuthorizationResponse.

tools.name: payment_create-authorization
tools.description: Capture an authorized payment (full or partial amount). Required: id, currency. Optional: decimal_places, value. Returns the new PaymentCapture.

params.name: decimal_places
params.description: Number of decimal places for this currency Common values: 2 for USD/EUR/GBP, 0 for JPY/KRW, 3 for BHD/KWD

params.name: value
params.description: Value in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD, yen for JPY) Example: 120.34 EUR = 12034, 1000 JPY = 1000

tools.name: payment_create-cart
tools.description: Create a payment authorization for a shopping cart quote using Stripe. Required: amount, quoted_cart_id. Returns the new PaymentAuthorizationResponse.

params.name: amount-decimal-places
params.description: Number of decimal places for this currency Common values: 2 for USD/EUR/GBP, 0 for JPY/KRW, 3 for BHD/KWD

params.name: amount-value
params.description: Value in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD, yen for JPY) Example: 120.34 EUR = 12034, 1000 JPY = 1000

tools.name: payment_create-stripe
tools.description: Get the Stripe client secret (PaymentIntent flow) or checkout URL (Checkout Session flow). Optional: payment_intent_id, quoted_cart_id. Returns the new ClientSecretResponse.

tools.name: payment_get
tools.description: Retrieve payment authorization information by ID. Required: id. Returns the PaymentAuthorization.

tools.name: payment_get-authorization
tools.description: Check the current status of a payment from Stripe and update local record. Required: id. Returns the PaymentAuthorization.

tools.name: payment_get-quote
tools.description: Retrieve payment authorization information by quote ID. Required: quote_id. Returns the PaymentAuthorization.

tools.name: shop_create
tools.description: Unified trip management endpoint. Accepts create / add_product / remove_product / set_travelers / remove_travelers actions and returns the resulting trip state. Optional: add_item, remove_item, trip_id (plus 1 more).

params.name: trip_id
params.description: existing cart ID; omit to create new

tools.name: shop_create-fulfillment
tools.description: Verify payment with Stripe API and transition fulfillment from awaiting_payment to processing. Required: fulfillment_cart_id. Optional: checkout_session_id, payment_intent_id. Returns the new ConfirmPaymentResponse.

tools.name: shop_create-fulfillment-2
tools.description: Retrieve current fulfillment orchestration status and results. Required: fulfillment_cart_id. Returns the new PullFulfillmentResponse.

tools.name: shop_create-fulfillment-3
tools.description: Schedule fulfillment orchestration for all successfully quoted products. Optional: cart_id, checkout_session_id, customer_contact (plus 6 more). Returns the new ScheduleFulfillmentResponse.

params.name: cart_id
params.description: Standard path: provide cart_id + quoted_cart_id + idempotency_key. payment_authorization_id is now optional — the server creates the Stripe payment at schedule time (PAYF-01).

params.name: checkout_session_id
params.description: CheckoutSessionID: alternative path — web app provides the Stripe checkout session ID after redirect. The server resolves quoted_cart_id and payment_auth automatically.

params.name: guest_data
params.description: GuestData is the MCP-client-facing field (matches swagger spec). Shape: { 'passengers': [...] }

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: PaymentIntentID: alternative path — web app provides the Stripe PaymentIntent ID after embedded payment confirmation. The server resolves quoted_cart_id and payment_auth automatically.

params.name: travelers
params.description: Travelers is the internal field used downstream. Populated from GuestData if not set directly.

tools.name: shop_create-quote
tools.description: Retrieve current quote orchestration status and results. Required: quoted_cart_id. Returns the new PullQuoteResponse.

tools.name: shop_create-quote-2
tools.description: Schedule quote orchestration for all products in a cart. Required: cart_id. Returns the new ScheduleQuoteResponse.

tools.name: shop_create-sync
tools.description: Selects or updates ancillaries (seats, bags, meals, assistance) for a trip item. The body references a trip_id and trip_item_token and provides the desired selection; the handler validates the selection against the item's available ancillary inventory. Required: trip_id. Optional: selections. Returns the new AncillaryResponse.

tools.name: shop_create-sync-2
tools.description: Starts the checkout flow for a trip (cart), creating a Stripe Checkout Session or PaymentIntent depending on the configured authorisation type. Required: trip_id. Returns the new CheckoutResponse.

tools.name: shop_get
tools.description: Retrieve a trip by ID. Required: id. Returns the TripResponse.

tools.name: shop_quoted_update
tools.description: Replace all ancillary selections on a quoted cart item (full-replace semantics). Required: cart_id, quoted_item_id. Optional: selections. Returns the updated SelectAncillariesResponse.

tools.name: shopping-cart_create
tools.description: Create a new shopping cart bound to a session. Required: platform, session_id, source, tenant. Optional: metadata, payment_type, user_id. Returns the new CartCreateResponse.

tools.name: shopping-cart_delete
tools.description: Remove a product from the shopping cart (soft delete). Required: cart_id, product_id. Returns the CartGetResponse. Destructive.

tools.name: shopping-cart_get
tools.description: Retrieve a shopping cart with its products. Required: cart_id. Returns the CartGetResponse.

tools.name: shopping-cart_get-shoppingcart
tools.description: Retrieve a specific product's details from the cart. Required: cart_id, product_id. Returns the CartProduct.

tools.name: shopping-cart_update
tools.description: Add a product to an existing shopping cart. Required: cart_id, domain. Optional: attributes, reference_id, snapshot. Returns the updated AddProductResponse.

tools.name: shopping-cart_update-shoppingcart
tools.description: Update contact info and/or travelers on a shopping cart. Required: cart_id. Optional: contact_info, travelers. Returns the updated ShoppingCartUpdateShoppingcartResponse.

tools.name: travelers_create
tools.description: Create a traveler profile. Optional: address, channel_user_id, date_of_birth (plus 14 more). Returns the new TravelerResponse.

tools.name: travelers_delete
tools.description: Delete a traveler profile. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: travelers_get
tools.description: Retrieve a traveler profile by ID. Required: id. Returns the TravelerResponse.

tools.name: travelers_list
tools.description: List traveler profiles for the authenticated user. Returns the TravelerListResponse.

tools.name: travelers_update
tools.description: Update a traveler profile. Required: id. Optional: address, channel_user_id, date_of_birth (plus 14 more). Returns the updated TravelerResponse.
